🪷 *வணக்கம்! Welcome to BJP Nalam Thittam*

Connect with Central Government welfare schemes.

How can we help you today?

📋 *Register*

Do you have your *Voter ID card (EPIC number)*?

✅ *Support Request Received!*

Our team will respond within *2 hours*.

For urgent help:
⏰ 8am – 10pm daily

Thank you! 🙏

📝 *Your Full Name*

Type your full name and send it — e.g. *Vijay Kumar*.

Then tap *Continue ✅* to choose your district.

📍 *Select Your District* (Page 1 of 5)

Choose your district from the list below:

🎯 *Select Schemes* (Page 1 of 4)

Tap a scheme to add it — you can add more after each one.
Tap *More Schemes* to see more.
